treatment: Restrained live-action suspense. Natural practical night lighting, muted blue and warm amber. Preserve Meera's blue kurta and the letter's right-pocket continuity. This text-only example demonstrates records, not visual consistency.

decisions.description: Use a restrained, realistic visual treatment.
The kurta is faded blue and the letter moves from table to right hand to right pocket.

beats.description: Meera enters the room wearing her faded blue kurta.
A folded letter is visible on the table.
Meera picks up the letter with her right hand.
Meera hides the letter in her right pocket.
Meera steps into the courtyard in the same costume; the letter remains concealed.
Meera says exactly: No one can know.

shots.visual_description: A small room at night. Meera wears a faded blue cotton kurta. A folded letter sits on a wooden table by the door.
shots.action: Meera enters through the doorway, notices the folded letter and stops beside the table.
shots.camera: Static medium-wide shot, doorway and tabletop both readable.
shots.lighting: A warm practical lamp illuminates the tabletop; soft blue night light enters from the doorway.
shots.audio: Quiet room tone and footsteps; no dialogue or music.
shots.start_state: Meera outside the doorway; letter folded on table.
shots.end_state: Meera beside table; letter remains folded on table.
acceptance_criteria: Entrance and folded letter are visible in the same shot
Meera wears the faded blue kurta

shots.visual_description: Meera in a faded blue cotton kurta stands beside the wooden table in the same small room.
shots.action: With her right hand Meera lifts the folded letter, opens and reads it, then folds and tucks it into her right kurta pocket. Her reaction is contained alarm.
shots.camera: Steady medium shot with face, right hand, tabletop and right pocket visible.
shots.lighting: The same warm practical lamp and soft blue doorway light.
shots.audio: Paper rustle and room tone; no dialogue or music.
shots.start_state: Meera beside table; letter remains folded on table.
shots.end_state: Letter concealed in Meera's right pocket; tabletop empty.
acceptance_criteria: Pickup, reading and concealment occur in that order
Letter stays in the right hand until placed in the right pocket

shots.visual_description: A quiet courtyard outside the small room at night. Meera wears the same faded blue cotton kurta.
shots.action: Meera steps outside, checks the empty courtyard and whispers: No one can know.
shots.camera: Medium tracking shot settling into a still frame on her face.
shots.lighting: Soft night light with a warm spill from the room behind her.
shots.audio: Meera whispers the exact line 'No one can know.' Quiet exterior ambience; no music. Use a dialogue-capable workflow.

shots.end_state: Meera in the courtyard; letter still concealed in her right pocket.
